summary: A man begs a lover not to leave after a night together, dreading the morning and what tomorrow brings.
A devoted partner promises steady, reliable love through hard times, using playful metaphors about being there.
A call to stop chasing money and enjoy music and each other together, rejecting consumerism and the spotlight.
A man who admits his flaws thanks a higher power for the partner who stays and steadies him.
A boastful rapper flaunts money, status and sexual conquest while urging a woman to join in on his terms.
A romance from a shy first kiss to a proposal and wedding, told with playful repeated lines.
A singer warns that drinking and a lover keep pulling him back, with each night nearly ruining him.
A restless traveler leaves a faithful woman behind, calling her from cold places but unable to settle down.
A boastful night out spending big, drinking hard and chasing women, treating every moment like it could be the last.
A bitter ex is hurt by a cold breakup and being treated like a stranger, still aching over lost love.
A flirtatious newcomer hands a stranger her number on the spot, hoping he will call her.
Friends and lovers drink at a bar, trying to burn bright and promise to carry each other home.
A jilted lover reflects on a failed romance from a payphone, while a rapper boasts and mocks the ex.
An anxious, isolated person finds comfort in distant lights calling them home, longing for safety and family.
An upbeat party night of flirting and seduction, with the singer thrilled that a new love showed up and stayed.
After a breakup, the singer declares she has grown stronger and moved on, refusing to be broken by her ex.
A party anthem urging dancers to let loose and fly high, with some bragging about money and drinks.
A boy tells a shy girl she is beautiful without knowing it and promises to show her what he sees.
Party-hungry singers boast about wild nights and sex, inviting a wild partner to join the club fun.
A heartbroken singer recalls a relationship that burned out, leaving her wounded and still haunted by the memory.
A restless singer questions identity and purpose, wrestling with loneliness, lost time and family pressure.
After a painful romance, the singer wakes up clear-eyed, letting go and realizing that things were not what they seemed.
A rapper boasts about his success and confidence, feeling great and urging listeners to enjoy the good life with him.
A playful, sexually suggestive braggart invites a partner to make him feel a thrill, boasting about his own skills.
A couple stuck in a toxic on-and-off romance keeps returning to each other, promising just one more night together.
A shy guy confesses he fell hard for a former lover who moved away, promising to be there for her.
A boastful rapper flaunts wealth, women and status in clubs, living by a you-only-live-once motto.
A singer searches everywhere for a lover who can truly please her, asking where he has been all her life.
A singer is hurt by gossip around a new relationship, as the talk drowns out what the couple wants.
A man offers to look after a hurt woman, promising care and understanding even though she was let down before.
A defiant singer shrugs off attacks and criticism, declaring she is unbreakable like titanium.
A singer vows to stay with a partner through rough times, choosing patience and love over walking away.
A singer warns a lover that losing her would leave him in endless rain and pleads with her to stay.
Rappers boast about luxury cars, money, parties and women in a braggy, crude and playful stream of wordplay.
A young suitor promises to treat a girl right, offering to be her boyfriend and never let her go.
A singer ends a close relationship to stay true to himself, feeling too close to love her.
A singer leaves a bad relationship and insists the ex cannot take away her strength, shining brighter on her own.
Friends celebrate carefree youth, smoking weed and drinking with no worries, living young, wild and free.
A singer refuses to reunite with an on-and-off ex, mocking his repeated comebacks and insisting it is over for good.
A couple vows to stay devoted through hardship, saying their love keeps them rich and strong no matter what.
A dance track in which a singer begs a lover cast as a doctor to save and turn her on.
An exhausted singer ends a draining relationship, taking one last goodbye kiss and planning to live freely on her own.
A carefree duo sings that it is always a good time, inviting friends to go out and have fun.
A singer reassures a guarded partner she is not like their ex, wanting to ease their fear of getting hurt.
Two rappers boast about spending big in Paris, living large, partying and playing basketball with swagger and bravado.
A singer mourns a lost high school love, wishing that in another life she could have kept him.
An electronic dance track repeating the feeling of being close to a lover right now, with nothing to stop them.
A seductive singer promises a passionate night to a woman he watches across the room, pledging she will scream.
A rapper boasts about money, luxury cars, strippers and women, celebrating a flashy lifestyle with crude bravado.
A singer describes a passionate dance-floor romance, feeling swept up and taken down by her partner like a domino.
